products.name: Software Renewals, Contracts & OEM Bundle Tracking — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable software renewals, contracts, and OEM bundle tracking process — a renewal calendar with lead-time alerts, a contract repository, OEM mapping, and procurement coordination so every renewal is a planned decision. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Never get blindsided by a software renewal again

Renewals arrive without warning, auto-renew at bad terms, or lapse and break something in production — and OEM bundles and contract terms live in people's inboxes. This solution builds a repeatable software renewals, contracts, and OEM bundle tracking process: a renewal calendar with lead-time alerts, a contract and entitlement repository, OEM/bundle mapping, and a procurement coordination workflow so every renewal is a planned decision.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the renewal lifecycle, the contract/entitlement repository model, OEM bundle mapping, lead-time alerting, and the procurement coordination workflow.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a contract/entitlement repository, renewal dates and terms, procurement contacts, an alerting mechanism) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory contracts and renewal dates, build the repository and calendar, map OEM bundles, set lead-time alerts, define the renewal decision workflow with procurement, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — contract/renewal discovery, renewal-data completeness validation, a renewal calendar and cost report, safe remediation of missing renewal records, and a renewal-owner group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every software renewal a planned decision — a renewal calendar with lead-time alerts, a contract repository, and procurement coordination — no more surprise auto-renewals or lapses, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SWRENEW-Discovery.ps1 — seed the contract/entitlement repository and report its current posture
    • SWRENEW-Remediation.ps1 — safely fill missing renewal records and advance closed renewals
    • SWRENEW-Report.ps1 — build the renewal calendar (with tiered lead-time alerts) and a cost rollup
    • SWRENEW-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the renewal-owner routing groups (pilot and all-products)
    • SWRENEW-Validation.ps1 — confirm the renewal repository has the fields the lifecycle needs

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
